mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (id, user_id, template_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status})
INSERT INTO task_assets (task_id, asset_id, asset_order) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{assetId}, #{assetOrder})
INSERT INTO task_steps (task_id, step_order, step_name, status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepName}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = 'PROCESSING', current_stage = #{stage}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE task_steps SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_name = #{stepName} AND status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE task_steps SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_name = #{stepName} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE task_steps SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = #{reason} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_name = #{stepName} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', current_stage = NULL, result_url = #{resultUrl}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'FAILED', current_stage = #{stage}, failure_stage = #{stage}, failure_reason = #{reason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, failure_stage, failure_reason, result_url, created_at, started_at, finished_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, task_id, step_order, step_name, status, started_at, finished_at, error_message FROM task_steps WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY step_order

#{assetId}
